info.title: TiDB Cloud Premium API
info.description:
*TiDB Cloud API is in beta.*

This API manages [TiDB Cloud Premium](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/select-cluster-tier/#tidb-cloud-premium) instances. For more information about TiDB Cloud API, see [TiDB Cloud API Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/api/tidb-cloud-api-overview/).

# Overview

The TiDB Cloud Premium API (v1beta2) provides [REST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/REST) endpoints to manage TiDB Cloud Premium instances and related resources.

You can use this API to manage the following resources:

- **TiDB Cloud Premium instance**: manage the lifecycle and configuration of TiDB Cloud Premium instances, including passwords, CA certificates, and cloud provider information.
- **Backup**: manage backups for TiDB Cloud Premium instances, including backup-based restore.
- **Changefeed**: manage the lifecycle and configuration of TiDB Cloud Premium changefeeds.
- **Region**: retrieve available regions for deploying TiDB Cloud Premium instances.

# Get Started

This guide helps you make your first API call to the TiDB Cloud Premium API. You will learn how to authenticate a request, build a request, and interpret the response.

1. Create a [TiDB Cloud account](https://tidbcloud.com/signup) if you do not already have one.
2. In the [TiDB Cloud console](https://tidbcloud.com/), go to **Organization** > **API Keys** and create an API key. For more information, see [API key management](#section/Authentication/API-key-management).
3. Make your first API call.

	To get all TiDB Cloud Premium instances in your organization, run the following command in your terminal. Replace `YOUR_PUBLIC_KEY` and `YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY` with your own key values.

	```bash
	curl --digest \
	  --user 'YOUR_PUBLIC_KEY:YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY' \
	  --request GET \
	  --url 'https://cloud.tidbapi.com/v1beta2/tidbs' \
	  --header 'Accept: application/json'
	```

4. The API returns a JSON list of your TiDB Cloud Premium instances. If none exist, the response contains an empty list.

# Authentication

The TiDB Cloud API uses [HTTP Digest Authentication](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digest_access_authentication). It protects your private key from being sent over the network. For more details about HTTP Digest Authentication, refer to the [IETF RFC](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7616).

## API key overview

- The API key contains a public key and a private key, which act as the username and password required in the HTTP Digest Authentication. The private key only displays upon the key creation.
- The API key belongs to your organization and acts as the `Organization Owner` role. You can check [permissions of owner](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/manage-user-access#configure-member-roles).
- You must provide the correct API key in every request. Otherwise, TiDB Cloud responds with a `401` error.

## API key management

### Create an API key

Only the **owner** of an organization can create an API key.

To create an API key in an organization, perform the following steps:

1. In the [TiDB Cloud console](https://tidbcloud.com), switch to your target organization using the combo box in the upper-left corner.
2. In the left navigation pane, click **Organization Settings** > **API Keys**.
3. On the **API Keys** page, click **Create API Key**.
4. Enter a description for your API key.
5. Configure the role and scope for the API key. For more information about the permissions of a role, see [User roles](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/manage-user-access/#user-roles).
6. Click **Generate API Key**. Copy and save the public key and the private key.
7. Make sure that you have copied and saved the private key in a secure location. The private key only displays upon the creation. After leaving this page, you will not be able to get the full private key again.
8. Click **Done**.

### View details of an API key

To view details of an API key, perform the following steps:

1. In the [TiDB Cloud console](https://tidbcloud.com), switch to your target organization using the combo box in the upper-left corner.
2. In the left navigation pane, click **Organization Settings** > **API Keys**.
3. You can view the details of the API keys on the page.

### Edit an API key

Only the **owner** of an organization can modify an API key.

To edit an API key in an organization, perform the following steps:

1. In the [TiDB Cloud console](https://tidbcloud.com), switch to your target organization using the combo box in the upper-left corner.
2. In the left navigation pane, click **Organization Settings** > **API Keys**.
3. On the **API Keys** page, click **...** in the API key row that you want to change, and then click **Update Role**.
4. You can update the description and role of the API key.
5. Click **Update**.

### Delete an API key

Only the **owner** of an organization can delete an API key.

To delete an API key in an organization, perform the following steps:

1. In the [TiDB Cloud console](https://tidbcloud.com), switch to your target organization using the combo box in the upper-left corner.
2. In the left navigation pane, click **Organization Settings** > **API Keys**.
3. On the **API Keys** page, click **...** in the API key row that you want to delete, and then click **Delete**.
4. Click **I understand, delete it.**

# API Changelog

This changelog lists all changes to the TiDB Cloud Premium API (v1beta2).

<!-- In reverse chronological order -->

## 20260908

- Add the following changefeed endpoints for data replication from TiDB Cloud Premium to downstream systems, including Apache Kafka, MySQL, Amazon S3, and Alibaba Cloud OSS:
	* [List changefeeds](#tag/Changefeed/operation/ListChangefeeds)
	* [Create a changefeed](#tag/Changefeed/operation/CreateChangefeed)
	* [Get a changefeed](#tag/Changefeed/operation/GetChangefeed)
	* [Delete a changefeed](#tag/Changefeed/operation/DeleteChangefeed)
	* [Edit a changefeed](#tag/Changefeed/operation/EditChangefeedDownstreamConfig)
	* [Pause a changefeed](#tag/Changefeed/operation/PauseChangefeed)
	* [Resume a changefeed](#tag/Changefeed/operation/ResumeChangefeed)
	* [Scale a changefeed](#tag/Changefeed/operation/ScaleChangefeed)
	* [List changefeed CCU options](#tag/Changefeed/operation/ListChangefeedCapacityUnits)

- Add the following endpoints for managing backups:
	* [Create a backup for a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/Backup/operation/TidbService_CreateTidbBackup)

## 20260609

- Add the following endpoint for managing backups:
	* [List backups](#tag/Backup/operation/BackupService_ListBackups)
	* [Delete a backup](#tag/Backup/operation/BackupService_DeleteBackup)

## 20260428

- Initial release of the TiDB Cloud Premium API (v1beta2), including the following resources and endpoints:
	* TiDB Cloud Premium instance
		* [List TiDB Cloud Premium instances](#tag/TiDB-Instance/operation/TidbService_ListTidbs)
		* [Create a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/TiDB-Instance/operation/TidbService_CreateTidb)
		* [Get a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/TiDB-Instance/operation/TidbService_GetTidb)
		* [Delete a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/TiDB-Instance/operation/TidbService_DeleteTidb)
		* [Update a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/TiDB-Instance/operation/TidbService_UpdateTidb)
		* [Reset the root password of a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/TiDB-Instance/operation/TidbService_ResetRootPassword)
		* [Get cloud provider information for a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/TiDB-Instance/operation/TidbService_GetCloudProviderInfo)
		* [Get the CA certificate download URL for a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/TiDB-Instance/operation/TidbService_GetCaCertificateDownloadUrl)
	* Backup
		* [List backups for a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/Backup/operation/TidbService_ListTidbBackups)
		* [Delete a backup for a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/Backup/operation/TidbService_DeleteTidbBackup)
		* [Restore a TiDB Cloud Premium instance from a backup](#tag/Backup/operation/TidbService_RestoreTidb)
		* [Get restore status for a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/Backup/operation/TidbService_GetRestoreStatus)
	* Region
		* [List regions](#tag/Region/operation/RegionService_ListRegions)

parameters.name: servicePlan
parameters.description:
The plan of the service. If specified, only TiDB Cloud Premium instances of the specified plan are returned.

- `Premium`: [TiDB Cloud Premium](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/select-cluster-tier/#tidb-cloud-premium)

parameters.name: regionIds
parameters.description: A list of region IDs. If specified, only TiDB Cloud Premium instances in these regions are returned.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The display name to filter by. If specified, only TiDB Cloud Premium instances whose display name contains this value are returned.

parameters.name: tidbIds

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of TiDB Cloud Premium instances to return. If not specified, at most 10 will be returned. The maximum value is `100`. Values greater than `100` are set to `100`.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:

**Note**: When paginating, all other parameters must match the original request.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of TiDB Cloud Premium instances to skip before returning results. If the value exceeds the total number of TiDB Cloud Premium instances, the response is `200` with an empty list and no `nextPageToken`.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description:
A list of backup states. If specified, only backups matching these states are returned.

 - UNKNOWN: The backup state is unknown.
 - PENDING: The backup is pending.
 - RUNNING: The backup is in progress.
 - SUCCEEDED: The backup completed successfully.
 - FAILED: The backup has failed.
 - CANCELLED: The backup is cancelled.

parameters.name: regionIds
parameters.description: A list of region IDs. If specified, only backups in these regions are returned.

parameters.name: triggerTypes
parameters.description:
A list of backup trigger types. If specified, only backups matching these trigger types are returned.

 - AUTO: The backup is triggered automatically by TiDB Cloud.
 - MANUAL: The backup is triggered manually by a user.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: The inclusive start of the backup time range, in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format. If specified, only backups at or after this time are returned.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The inclusive end of the backup time range, in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format. If specified, only backups at or before this time are returned.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of backups to return. If not specified, at most 10 backups will be returned. The maximum value is `100`. Values greater than `100` are set to `100`.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token received from a previous [List backups for a TiDB Cloud Premium instance](#tag/Backup/operation/TidbService_ListTidbBackups) request. Use this token to retrieve the next page of results.

**Note**: When paginating, all other parameters must match the original request.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of backups to skip before returning results. If the value exceeds the total number of backups, the response is `200` with an empty list and no `nextPageToken`.

parameters.name: downstreamType
parameters.description:
Filters changefeeds by downstream type. If omitted or set to `DOWNSTREAM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED`, all downstream types are returned.

- `KAFKA`: Apache Kafka.
- `MYSQL`: MySQL-compatible database.
- `S3`: Amazon S3 or S3-compatible storage.

parameters.description: The maximum number of changefeeds to return. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token received from a previous [List changefeeds](#tag/Changefeed/operation/ListChangefeeds) request. Use this token to retrieve the next page of results.

**Note**: When paginating, all other parameters must match the original request.

post.description:
Creates a new changefeed for replicating data to a downstream system.

For S3-compatible storage, Alibaba Cloud OSS is supported through the S3-compatible endpoint. To use Alibaba Cloud OSS, set `downstreamType` to `S3`, set `provider` to `ALIBABA_OSS`, and configure the S3 endpoint with a `s3://{bucket_name}/{prefix}/` URI, a regional custom endpoint such as `https://s3.oss-{region_id}.aliyuncs.com`, and `S3_AUTH_TYPE_AK_SK` authentication.

Currently, Alibaba Cloud OSS only supports Access Key and Secret Key authentication. IAM Assume Role authentication is not supported.

Configure the key according to the cloud provider:
- AWS: set `awsKms` and `awsPrincipal`.
- Alibaba Cloud: set `aliyunKms` and `aliyunPrincipal`.

TidbDualLayerDataEncryption.description: The dual-layer data encryption configuration for a TiDB Cloud Premium instance. Specify exactly one of the following options: `noEncryption`, `defaultKey`, or `cmek`.

host.description:
The hostname of the endpoint.

When `connectionType` is `"PRIVATE_ENDPOINT"`, the behavior of the `host` field varies by cloud provider:
- For AWS, this field is available after the Private Link service is ready.
- For Google Cloud and Azure, this field is available after you create a private endpoint connection.

port.description: The port number of the endpoint.

connectionType.description:
The connection type of the endpoint.

- `PUBLIC`: a public endpoint. For more information, see [Network](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/connect-to-tidb-instance/#network).

- `PRIVATE_ENDPOINT`: a private endpoint. For more information, see [Network](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/connect-to-tidb-instance/#network).

- `VPC_PEERING`: a VPC peering endpoint (not yet supported, planned for a future release).

connectionReachability.description: The reachability status of the endpoint connection.

TidbHighAvailabilityType.description:
The high availability configuration for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

 - REGIONAL: High availability across multiple availability zones within a region.
 - ZONAL: High availability within a single availability zone.

rootPassword.description:
The new root password.

This field supports two input formats:
- Plaintext password (legacy behavior)
- RSA-OAEP-SHA256 encrypted payload prefixed with `rsa_oaep_sha256:`

If the marker prefix is present, the server parses and decrypts the encrypted payload.
Any parse/decrypt failure returns an explicit parameter error without plaintext fallback.
If the marker prefix is absent, the value is treated as plaintext for backward compatibility.

For plaintext input, the password must be between 8 and 64 characters long.

name.description: The unique identifier for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance, which is generated by the API and follows the format `tidbs/{tidbId}`.

tidbId.description: The ID of the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

displayName.description: The user-defined name of the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

regionId.description: The unique identifier of the region where the TiDB Cloud Premium instance is deployed, in the format of `{cloud_provider}-{region_code}`. For example, `aws-us-west-2`.

cloudProvider.description:
The cloud provider where the TiDB Cloud Premium instance is deployed.

- `"aws"`: Amazon Web Services

- `"gcp"`: Google Cloud

- `"azure"`: Microsoft Azure

- `"alicloud"`: Alibaba Cloud

regionDisplayName.description: The display name of the region where the TiDB Cloud Premium instance is deployed. For example, `Oregon (us-west-2)`.

state.description: The current state of the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

rootPassword.description:
The root password of the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

This field supports two input formats:
- Plaintext password (legacy behavior)
- RSA-OAEP-SHA256 encrypted payload prefixed with `rsa_oaep_sha256:`

If the marker prefix is present, the server parses and decrypts the encrypted payload.
Any parse/decrypt failure returns an explicit parameter error without plaintext fallback.
If the marker prefix is absent, the value is treated as plaintext for backward compatibility.

For plaintext input, the password must be between 8 and 64 characters long and can contain letters,
numbers, and special characters.

minRcu.description:
The minimum number of Request Capacity Units (RCUs) for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

This field is read-only and is automatically calculated as `max(5000, maxRcu / 4)`.

maxRcu.description: The maximum number of Request Capacity Units (RCUs) for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

servicePlan.description:
The plan of the service.

- `Premium`: [TiDB Cloud Premium](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/select-cluster-tier/#tidb-cloud-premium)

highAvailabilityType.description:
The high availability configuration for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.
- `REGIONAL`: high availability across multiple availability zones within a region. This is the only supported mode for TiDB Cloud Premium instances. For more information, see [Regional high availability architecture](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/serverless-high-availability/#regional-high-availability-architecture).
- `ZONAL`: high availability within a single availability zone. This mode is not supported for TiDB Cloud Premium instances and is reserved for other service plans. For more information, see [Zonal high availability architecture](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/serverless-high-availability/#zonal-high-availability-architecture).

annotations.description:
The annotations for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance. The following lists some predefined annotations:
- `tidb.cloud/has-set-password`: indicates whether the TiDB Cloud Premium instance has a root password set.
- `tidb.cloud/available-features`: lists available features of the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

labels.description:
The labels for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.
- `tidb.cloud/organization`: the ID of the organization where the TiDB Cloud Premium instance belongs.
- `tidb.cloud/project`: the ID of the project where the TiDB Cloud Premium instance belongs.

creator.description: The email address or public API key of the user who created the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

createTime.description: The timestamp when the TiDB Cloud Premium instance was created, in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

updateTime.description: The timestamp when the TiDB Cloud Premium instance was last updated, in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

endpoints.description: The connection endpoints for accessing the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

dualLayerDataEncryption.description: The dual-layer data encryption configuration for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

tidbVersion.description: The version of the TiDB instance.

capacityUpdateTime.description: The timestamp when the capacity of the TiDB Cloud Premium instance was last updated, in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

code.description: The error code returned with this error.

message.description: The error message returned with this error.

details.description: A list of messages with additional error details.

rpcStatus.description:
The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for
different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is
used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains
three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details.

You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the
[API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

v1beta1ClusterState.description:
The possible states of a TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

 - CREATING: The TiDB Cloud Premium instance is being created.
 - DELETING: The TiDB Cloud Premium instance is being deleted.
 - ACTIVE: The TiDB Cloud Premium instance is active for use.
 - RESTORING: Data for the TiDB Cloud Premium instance is being restored.
 - MAINTENANCE: The TiDB Cloud Premium instance is under maintenance.
 - DELETED: The TiDB Cloud Premium instance has been deleted.
 - INACTIVE: The TiDB Cloud Premium instance is not active, but is not being deleted.
 - UPGRADING: Cluster is being updated.
Only for Dedicated Cluster.
 - IMPORTING: Cluster is being imported.
Only for Dedicated Cluster.
 - MODIFYING: Cluster is being modified.
Only for Dedicated Cluster.
 - PAUSING: Cluster is being paused.
Only for Dedicated Cluster.
 - PAUSED: Cluster is paused.
Only for Dedicated Cluster.
 - RESUMING: Cluster is resuming.
Only for Dedicated Cluster.

v1beta2RestoreMode.description:
The mode used to restore a TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

 - SNAPSHOT: Restores from native snapshot backup data of a TiDB Cloud Premium instance.
 - PITR: Restores from native point-in-time recovery (PITR) backup data of a TiDB Cloud Premium instance.
 - DEDICATED_SNAPSHOT: Restores from snapshot backup data of a TiDB Cloud Dedicated cluster.
 - CLASSIC_SNAPSHOT: Restores from snapshot backup data stored in object storage of a classic TiDB.

v1beta2RestoreState.description:
The current state of the restore operation.

 - UNKNOWN: The state of the restore operation is unknown.
 - PENDING: The restore operation is pending.
 - RUNNING: The restore operation is in progress.
 - SUCCEEDED: The restore operation completed successfully.
 - FAILED: The restore operation has failed.
 - CANCELLED: The restore operation is cancelled.

The configuration of the TiDB Cloud Premium instance to create.

The ID of the backup to restore from.

This field is required when `restoreMode` is `"SNAPSHOT"` or `"DEDICATED_SNAPSHOT"`.

pointInTime.description:
The point in time to restore data to, in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

This field is required when `restoreMode` is `"PITR"`.

classicBackupStorage.description:
The classic backup storage configuration.

This field is required when `restoreMode` is `"CLASSIC_SNAPSHOT"`.

tidb.description: The restored TiDB Cloud Premium instance.

AvroConfigBigintUnsignedHandlingMode.description:
BigintUnsignedHandlingMode defines how BIGINT UNSIGNED values are handled.

 - BIGINT_UNSIGNED_HANDLING_MODE_LONG: Use 64-bit integer (may overflow for very large values).
 - BIGINT_UNSIGNED_HANDLING_MODE_STRING: Use string representation (safe for all values).

AvroConfigDecimalHandlingMode.description:
DecimalHandlingMode defines how decimal values are serialized.

 - DECIMAL_HANDLING_MODE_PRECISE: Use precise decimal representation.
 - DECIMAL_HANDLING_MODE_STRING: Use string representation.

schemaRegistryEndpoints.description: The comma-separated list of Schema Registry endpoints. Required for Confluent Schema Registry.

enableBasicAuth.description: Indicates whether to enable HTTP basic authentication for Schema Registry.

basicAuthUsername.description: The basic authentication username for Schema Registry.

basicAuthPassword.description: The basic authentication password for Schema Registry.

downstreamType.description: The downstream type for a changefeed. Must match the existing downstream type (cannot be changed).

ChangefeedServiceScaleChangefeedBody.description: The request for scaling a changefeed.

ChangefeedState.description:
State defines the possible states of a changefeed.

 - STATE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. Should not be used.
 - RUNNING: Changefeed is actively replicating data.
 - FAILED: Changefeed encountered a fatal error and stopped.
 - ERROR: Changefeed encountered an error but may recover.
 - CREATING: Changefeed is being created.
 - PAUSING: Changefeed is in the process of pausing.
 - PAUSED: Changefeed is paused.
 - DELETING: Changefeed is being deleted.
 - DELETED: Changefeed has been deleted.
 - EDITING: Changefeed configuration is being updated.
 - WARNING: Changefeed is running but has warnings.
 - SCALING: Changefeed is being scaled.
 - RESUMING: Changefeed is being resumed.

decimalHandlingMode.description:
The decimal serialization mode. The default value is `DECIMAL_HANDLING_MODE_PRECISE`.

- `"DECIMAL_HANDLING_MODE_PRECISE"`: Use precise decimal representation.

- `"DECIMAL_HANDLING_MODE_STRING"`: Use string representation.

bigintUnsignedHandlingMode.description:
The handling mode for BIGINT UNSIGNED values.

- `"BIGINT_UNSIGNED_HANDLING_MODE_LONG"`: Use 64-bit integer (may overflow for very large values).

- `"BIGINT_UNSIGNED_HANDLING_MODE_STRING"`: Use string representation (safe for all values).

outputOldValue.description: Indicates whether to output the old value before the change.

disableSchema.description: Indicates whether to disable the schema in Debezium messages.

EndpointProvider.description:
Provider defines the S3-compatible object storage provider.

 - PROVIDER_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. Uses AWS S3 behavior.
 - AWS: Amazon S3.
 - ALIBABA_OSS: Alibaba Cloud OSS through its S3-compatible endpoint.

EndpointS3AuthType.description:
S3AuthType defines the supported S3 authentication types.

 - S3_AUTH_TYPE_AK_SK: Access Key / Secret Key authentication.
 - S3_AUTH_TYPE_ASSUME_ROLE: IAM Assume Role authentication.

version.description:
The Kafka broker version.

- `"KAFKA_VERSION_UNSPECIFIED"`: Default value. Must not be used.

- `"KAFKA_VERSION_1XX"`: Kafka 1.x

- `"KAFKA_VERSION_2XX"`: Kafka 2.x

- `"KAFKA_VERSION_3XX"`: Kafka 3.x

brokerEndpoints.description: The comma-separated list of Kafka broker addresses. Required for PUBLIC and VPC_PEERING network types. For PRIVATE_LINK, this field can be omitted; the server assembles broker endpoints from `networkInfo.sinkEndpointId` and `networkInfo.ports`.

useTls.description: Indicates whether to use TLS for the Kafka connection. The default value is false.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Indicates whether to skip TLS certificate verification. The default value is false. Only enable this field for testing with self-signed certificates.

compression.description:
The Kafka message compression type. The default value is `NONE`.

- `"NONE"`: No compression.

- `"GZIP"`: GZIP compression.

- `"SNAPPY"`: Snappy compression.

- `"LZ4"`: LZ4 compression.

- `"ZSTD"`: ZSTD compression.

kafkaClientId.description: The optional Kafka client ID. When left empty, a system default is used.

matcher.description: The table name patterns to match for column selection.

columns.description: The column names to include for the matched tables.

KafkaDownstreamConfigColumnSelector.description: The column filtering configuration for specific tables.

KafkaDownstreamConfigKafkaVersion.description:
KafkaVersion defines supported Kafka broker versions.

 - KAFKA_VERSION_1XX: Kafka 1.x
 - KAFKA_VERSION_2XX: Kafka 2.x
 - KAFKA_VERSION_3XX: Kafka 3.x

dispatchType.description:
The message dispatch type to topics. This field is required, and the API does not provide a default dispatch type. Specify one of the following values.

- `"DISPATCH_TYPE_ONE_TOPIC"`: All messages go to a single topic.

- `"DISPATCH_TYPE_BY_TABLE"`: Each table gets its own topic.

- `"DISPATCH_TYPE_BY_DATABASE"`: Each database gets its own topic.

defaultTopic.description: The default topic for dispatching all messages when dispatchType is DISPATCH_TYPE_ONE_TOPIC.

topicPrefix.description: The topic name prefix for dispatch types that create per-table or per-database topics.

separator.description: The separator between the prefix and the table or database name.

topicSuffix.description: The topic name suffix for dispatch types that create per-table or per-database topics.

replicationFactor.description: The replication factor for auto-created topics.

partitionNum.description: The number of partitions for auto-created topics.

NetworkInfoNetworkType.description:
The network type for downstream connectivity.

 - NETWORK_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value.
 - NETWORK_TYPE_PUBLIC: Public internet access.
 - NETWORK_TYPE_VPC_PEERING: AWS VPC Peering.
 - NETWORK_TYPE_PRIVATE_LINK: Private endpoint connectivity managed by TiDB Cloud.

S3DataFormatBinaryEncodingMethod.description:
BinaryEncodingMethod defines how binary values are encoded.

 - BASE64: Base64 encoding.
 - HEX: Hexadecimal encoding.

S3DataFormatDateSeparator.description:
DateSeparator defines the date separator options for directory structure.

 - NONE: No date separator.
 - YEAR: Separate by year.
 - MONTH: Separate by month.
 - DAY: Separate by day.

TopicPartitionConfigDispatchType.description:
DispatchType defines how messages are dispatched to topics.

 - DISPATCH_TYPE_ONE_TOPIC: All messages go to a single topic.
 - DISPATCH_TYPE_BY_TABLE: Each table gets its own topic.
 - DISPATCH_TYPE_BY_DATABASE: Each database gets its own topic.

TopicPartitionConfigPartitionDispatcher.description:
PartitionDispatcher defines the partition dispatch strategies.

 - TABLE: Dispatch by table name.
 - INDEX_VALUE: Dispatch by index value.
 - TIMESTAMP: Dispatch by timestamp.
 - COLUMNS: Dispatch by column values.

partitionType.description:
The partition dispatch strategy. This field is required, and the API does not provide a default strategy. Specify one of the following values.

- `"TABLE"`: Dispatch by table name.

- `"INDEX_VALUE"`: Dispatch by index value.

- `"TIMESTAMP"`: Dispatch by timestamp.

- `"COLUMNS"`: Dispatch by column values.

indexName.description: The index name for the INDEX_VALUE partition dispatcher.

columns.description: The column names for the COLUMNS partition dispatcher.

 - MYSQL: MySQL-compatible database.
 - S3: Amazon S3 or S3-compatible storage.

ignoredEvents.description: The event types to ignore. Supported values include DML events such as `insert`, `update`, `delete`, and `all dml`, and DDL events such as `create schema`, `drop table`, `alter table`, and `all ddl`. For the complete list of supported values, see [Changefeed Log Filters](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/ticdc-filter/).

 - SASL_SCRAM_SHA_512: SASL/SCRAM-SHA-512 authentication.

v1beta2KafkaDownstreamConfigCompressionT.description:
CompressionType defines the compression types for Kafka messages.

 - NONE: No compression.
 - GZIP: GZIP compression.
 - SNAPPY: Snappy compression.
 - LZ4: LZ4 compression.
 - ZSTD: ZSTD compression.

protocol.description:
The Kafka output protocol. This field is required, and the API does not provide a default protocol. Specify one of the following values.

- `"PROTOCOL_CANAL_JSON"`: Canal JSON format. Recommended for most use cases.

- `"PROTOCOL_OPEN_PROTOCOL"`: Open Protocol (TiDB native format). Encodes multiple events into one message.

- `"PROTOCOL_AVRO"`: Apache Avro format.

- `"PROTOCOL_DEBEZIUM"`: Debezium JSON format.

- `"PROTOCOL_DEBEZIUM_AVRO"`: Debezium events encoded with Avro.

enableTidbExtension.description: Indicates whether to enable TiDB extension fields. The default value is false. For more information, see https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/ticdc-avro-protocol.

outputRawChangeEvent.description: Indicates whether to output raw change events. The default value is false. For more information, see https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/ticdc-split-transaction-by-memory.

v1beta2KafkaDownstreamConfigDataFormat.description: The Kafka message format and serialization configuration.

v1beta2KafkaDownstreamConfigDataFormatPr.description:
Protocol defines the supported output protocols.

 - PROTOCOL_CANAL_JSON: Canal JSON format. Recommended for most use cases.
 - PROTOCOL_OPEN_PROTOCOL: Open Protocol (TiDB native format). Encodes multiple events into one message.
 - PROTOCOL_AVRO: Apache Avro format. Supports Confluent Schema Registry and AWS Glue Schema Registry.
 - PROTOCOL_DEBEZIUM: Debezium format.
 - PROTOCOL_DEBEZIUM_AVRO: Debezium events encoded with Avro.

ccus.description: The list of available CCU options.

v1beta2ListCCUsResponse.description: The response for listing changefeed CCU options.

changefeeds.description: The list of changefeeds matching the query.

totalSize.description: The total number of changefeeds across all pages.

nextPageToken.description: The page token for the next page. This field is empty when there are no more pages.

networkType.description:
The network type for downstream connectivity.

- `"NETWORK_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED"`: Default value.

- `"NETWORK_TYPE_PUBLIC"`: Public internet access.

- `"NETWORK_TYPE_VPC_PEERING"`: AWS VPC Peering.

- `"NETWORK_TYPE_PRIVATE_LINK"`: Private endpoint connectivity managed by TiDB Cloud. Create a private endpoint for the external service in the console UI and assign it to `sinkEndpointId`.

sinkEndpointId.description: The ID of the downstream network endpoint for an external service. Required when `networkType` is `NETWORK_TYPE_PRIVATE_LINK`.

ports.description: The ports for private endpoint connectivity. Required when networkType is `NETWORK_TYPE_PRIVATE_LINK`. The server uses these ports to construct broker endpoints as `<sink_endpoint_address>:<port>`.

v1beta2NetworkInfo.description: The network configuration for downstream connectivity.

protocol.description:
The output protocol. This field is required, and the API does not provide a default protocol. Specify one of the following values.

- `"PROTOCOL_CSV"`: CSV format.

- `"PROTOCOL_CANAL_JSON"`: Canal JSON format.

terminator.description: The row terminator used to separate data change events. This configuration is only used for storage sinks. The default value is a newline character ("\n"). When the field is omitted or empty, a newline is used.

dateSeparator.description:
The date separator for the directory structure. The default value is `NONE`.

- `"NONE"`: No date separator.

- `"YEAR"`: Separate by year.

- `"MONTH"`: Separate by month.

- `"DAY"`: Separate by day.

enableTidbExtension.description: Indicates whether to enable TiDB extension fields in Canal-JSON messages. The default value is false.

delimiter.description: The field delimiter for CSV files. Required when protocol is `PROTOCOL_CSV`. The value must be an ASCII character.

quote.description: The quotation character for CSV fields. The default value is `"`. When the value is empty, the default quotation character is retained.

null.description: The null representation for CSV columns. The default value is `\N`.

includeCommitTs.description: Indicates whether to include the commit timestamp in CSV rows. The default value is false.

binaryEncodingMethod.description:
The binary encoding method. The default value is `BASE64`.

- `"BASE64"`: Base64 encoding.

- `"HEX"`: Hexadecimal encoding.

outputRawChangeEvent.description: Indicates whether to output raw change events. The default value is false. For more information, see https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/ticdc-split-transaction-by-memory.

outputFieldHeader.description: Indicates whether to include the CSV field header. The default value is false.

v1beta2S3DataFormatProtocol.description:
Protocol defines the supported output protocols for cloud storage sinks.

 - PROTOCOL_CSV: CSV format.
 - PROTOCOL_CANAL_JSON: Canal JSON format.

s3Uri.description:
The S3 bucket URI. For example, `s3://bucket/prefix/`. The URI must end with a trailing slash.

For Alibaba Cloud OSS, use the S3-compatible URI format `s3://{bucket_name}/{prefix}/`. Do not use the raw OSS URI format.

authType.description:
The S3 authentication type. This field is required, and the API does not provide a default authentication type. Specify one of the following values.

- `"S3_AUTH_TYPE_AK_SK"`: Access Key / Secret Key authentication.

- `"S3_AUTH_TYPE_ASSUME_ROLE"`: IAM Assume Role authentication.

For Alibaba Cloud OSS, only `S3_AUTH_TYPE_AK_SK` is currently supported.

accessKey.description: The access key for S3 authentication. This field is required when authType is S3_AUTH_TYPE_AK_SK.

secretKey.description: The secret key for S3 authentication. This field is required when authType is S3_AUTH_TYPE_AK_SK. This field is input-only and not returned in responses.

iamAssumedRoleArn.description: The IAM assumed role ARN for S3 authentication. This field is required when authType is S3_AUTH_TYPE_ASSUME_ROLE.

customEndpoint.description: The custom S3-compatible endpoint. Required for Alibaba OSS.

provider.description:
The object storage provider. If omitted or set to `"PROVIDER_UNSPECIFIED"`, AWS S3 behavior is used.

- `"AWS"`: Amazon S3.

- `"ALIBABA_OSS"`: Alibaba Cloud OSS through its S3-compatible endpoint.

mode.description:
The start position mode.

- `"MODE_UNSPECIFIED"`: Default value.

- `"FROM_NOW"`: Start from the current time.

- `"FROM_TSO"`: Start from a specific TSO.

- `"FROM_UTC"`: Start from a specific UTC timestamp.

startTso.description: The start TSO. This field is required when the mode is `FROM_TSO`.

startTimestamp.description: The start UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 format. This field is required when the mode is `FROM_UTC`.

v1beta2StartPosition.description: The start position for the changefeed.

v1beta2StartPositionMode.description:
Mode defines the start position mode.

 - MODE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value.
 - FROM_NOW: Start from the current time.
 - FROM_TSO: Start from a specific TSO.
 - FROM_UTC: Start from a specific UTC timestamp.

interval.description: The flush interval as a duration string. The range is from 2s to 10m. The default value is 1m.

fileSize.description: The file size threshold in bytes. Data is flushed when this size is reached. The range is from 1048576 (1 MB) to 536870912 (512 MB). The default value is 67108864 (64 MB).

filterRules.description: The table filter rules. For example: `["mydb.orders", "mydb.user_*", "!mydb.secret_*"]` Refer [TiCDC Table Filter](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/ticdc-filter/#table-filter) for supported syntax.

mode.description:
The mode for handling unsupported tables.

- `"MODE_UNSPECIFIED"`: Default value. Must not be used.

- `"IGNORE_NOT_SUPPORT_TABLE"`: Skip unsupported tables silently.

- `"FORCE_SYNC"`: Force sync all tables (may fail on unsupported tables).

caseSensitive.description: Indicates whether the filter rules are case-sensitive. The default value is false.

eventFilters.description: The event filter rules for fine-grained control.

v1beta2TableConfig.description: The table filtering and event filter configuration.

v1beta2TableConfigMode.description:
Mode defines how to handle tables that are not supported by the changefeed.

 - MODE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value.
 - IGNORE_NOT_SUPPORT_TABLE: Skip unsupported tables silently.
 - FORCE_SYNC: Force sync all tables (may fail on unsupported tables).

name.description: The name of the manual backup.

backupId.description: The ID of the created backup.
